java.say: The list holds a Lion and a Penguin. It only knows them as Animal.
The loop takes the first animal, the Lion.
The call makeSound() runs the Lion's method, because the real object is a Lion.
The loop takes the next animal, the Penguin.
The same line now runs the Penguin's method. One call, different behaviour: that is polymorphism.

cpp.say: The list holds a Lion and a Penguin. It only knows them as Animal.
The loop takes the first animal, the Lion.
makeSound() is virtual, so C++ runs the method of the real object, a Lion.
The loop takes the next animal, the Penguin.
The same line now runs the Penguin's method. One call, different behaviour: that is polymorphism.
